brief:
Israeli drone strikes killed seven Palestinians in central Gaza, Al Jazeera English reported. The attacks occurred as Israel continues military operations in the territory despite a ceasefire agreement.

The drone strikes have intensified fear and panic among the Palestinian population across the Strip, according to reports. Palestinians have faced ongoing Israeli military operations amid what was described as a ceasefire period.
dek: Drones cause 'fear and panic' among Palestinians as Israel continues attacks on the Strip despite 'ceasefire'.
title: Israeli drone attacks kill seven Palestinians in central Gaza
